erroreClasseNonDiPrimaria: This class isn’t part of primary school: the primary register doesn’t apply to it.
erroreGradoNonAbilitato: You aren’t enabled for this school level: ask the office to update your profile.
erroreFirmaNonSalvata: We couldn’t save the register signature. Please try again in a few minutes.
erroreGalleriaMediaNelCestino: This photo is in the bin: restore it before editing it.
erroreGalleriaCestinoNonDisponibile: The gallery bin isn’t available on this installation: the photo was not deleted. Please tell the office.
erroreGalleriaMediaNonTrovato: This photo no longer exists: refresh the bin list.
erroreMediaNonRipristinabile: This photo can’t be restored: it isn’t in the bin, or its file was destroyed when the 30 days ran out. Refresh the list.
erroreGalleriaRipristinoNonDisponibile: The gallery bin isn’t available on this installation: the photo was not restored. Please tell the office.
erroreMediaNonRipristinato: We couldn’t restore the photo: it’s still in the bin. Please try again in a few minutes.
erroreConciliazioneNonQuadra: The items don’t add up to the bank transfer amount: fix the figures before confirming.
erroreConciliazioneSedeNonAccessibile: One of the items belongs to a location you can’t manage: remove it from the payment.
erroreConciliazioneAncoraMancante: Choose the item the invoice details are taken from: that is where the payer and the document location come from.
erroreConciliazioneMovimentoCambiato: Someone else has just changed this bank transfer: reload the list and compose the payment again.
erroreRiaperturaConFatturaViva: The bank transfer was reopened, but valid invoices remain on the item it was matched to: the document stays in force and can only be closed with a credit note.
erroreConciliazioneMovimentoNonTrovato: This bank transfer no longer exists: refresh the list of bank transfers.
erroreConciliazioneContestoNonLetto: We could not load this family’s open items: do not compose the payment until the list loads. Please try again in a few minutes.
erroreConciliazionePaganteNonAmmesso: This parent is not linked to the children named by this bank transfer: pick one of the proposed ones.
erroreConciliazioneAlunnoNonAttivo: One of the items is for a child who is no longer enrolled: remove it from the payment, or collect an item already on record.
erroreConciliazioneNonDisponibile: Composing a payment is not available in this environment: no payment has been recorded.
erroreConciliazioneNonRegistrata: We could not record the payment: nothing was written. Please try again shortly.
erroreRiaperturaFattureNonVerificate: We could not check whether any valid invoices remain for this bank transfer: it was reopened anyway. Please review the item’s documents before matching it again.
erroreRiaperturaNonDisponibile: Reopening a combined bank transfer is not available in this environment: nothing was reversed.
erroreRiaperturaCreditoGiaSpeso: The credit generated by this bank transfer has already been used: recover the spent credit first, then reopen.
erroreRiaperturaNonRiuscita: We could not complete the reopening of this bank transfer: the row has not gone back to the queue. Please try again: if a reversal had already been recorded, the second attempt recognises it and will not repeat it.
erroreMovimentoNonLetto: We could not read this bank statement row: it has not disappeared, the read itself failed. Please try again shortly.
erroreRiaperturaStornataNonRiaperta: The payment recorded for this bank transfer has been reversed, but the row has not gone back to the queue. Reload the list and reopen the bank transfer again: the second attempt recognises the reversal already recorded and will not repeat it.
erroreRiaperturaSedeNonVerificata: We could not verify the location of this combined bank transfer: the reopening was stopped and no reversal was made. Please try again shortly.
erroreConciliazioneVoceContenitore: One of the selected items is the total of an instalment plan: you collect the instalments, not the container. Remove it from the composition and pick the instalments to settle.
erroreConciliazioneMovimentoNonLegato: The payment has been recorded, but the bank statement row was not linked: do not repeat the operation, the money would be recorded twice. Report it so that the row can be linked.
errorePossibileDoppione: A child with the same name and date of birth, but a different tax code, is already enrolled at this location: if the family sent the application twice, reject this one; if it is the same child, use the existing record.
erroreAbbinamentoNonValido: The existing record indicated cannot be used for this child: nothing was saved. Reopen the application and try the import again.
erroreVideoFileNonValido: This file does not contain a readable video: it may be incomplete, or it may have been spoiled while being saved. Please try another clip.
erroreVideoTroppoGrande: This video is larger than 2 GB. Record it at a lower quality, or upload only the part you want to show.
erroreVideoTroppoLungo: This video is longer than 3 minutes. Please shorten it before uploading: on a phone you can trim it straight from the clip library.
erroreVideoFormatoNonSupportato: We cannot convert this video format. Please try a clip filmed with a phone, or save it as MP4.
erroreVideoProtetto: This video is copy protected and cannot be converted: please choose a clip you filmed yourself.
erroreVideoNonLeggibile: We cannot open this video: the file looks spoiled. Try downloading it again on your phone and uploading it once more.
erroreVideoConversioneNonRiuscita: We could not prepare this video, and nothing was published. Please try again: if it happens again, let the office know.
erroreVideoRiprova: Something changed while the video was being uploaded. Reload the page and try again: nothing has been lost.
erroreVideoGiaConcluso: This post has already been completed or withdrawn: reload the page to see how it stands now.
erroreVideoNonAncoraPronto: The videos are not ready yet. Please wait until they are and try again: you can close the app, the work carries on by itself.
erroreVideoNonTrovato: This upload no longer exists: it may have been called off, or it may have expired. Please start again.
erroreVideoNonAutorizzato: This upload belongs to someone else, or to another location: nothing has been changed.
erroreVideoAppDaAggiornare: Uploading videos needs the latest version: update the app, or reload the page if you are on a browser. Clips already waiting will resume by themselves.
erroreVideoOperazioneNonRiuscita: The operation on this video did not succeed: please try again shortly. If it keeps happening, report it to the office.
errorePeriodoTroppoLungo: That date range is too long: the register is read one stretch at a time. Please narrow the range, for example to a single term.
errorePeriodoRovesciato: The end date comes before the start date: please check the range.
